Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 10 minutes Number of Servings: 3 Ingredients 1 cup low-fat yogurt (try peach, vanilla or lemon) 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk 1/2 banana 3/4 cup orange juice 1/2 cup frozen peaches Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until smooth. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: 1 cup chopped or sliced peaches (about 1.5 to 2 medium fresh) Serve as a snack or dessert during the summer months.
